_comment: Zones for the sample multi-camera setup. Polygons are [x, y] pixel pairs in
the camera's own frame, so a zone only makes sense for the camera it was
drawn on — 'doorway' at 640x480 means nothing on a 1920x1080 stream.
Drawing them in the UI (Zones pane) is easier than writing them by hand;
this file exists so you can see the format and check one into a repo.
A box is assigned to the first zone that contains it, so order matters:
put the specific zones before the catch-all ones.
